name: AfeJvApprovalConsole
tagline: Raise, approve, ballot, track and close every AFE – with your JV partners in the loop.
description: A complete Authority for Expenditure desk for oil & gas operators in one Power Apps code component: AFE requests with cost estimates, an internal approval chain set by amount, non-operated partner ballots with consent thresholds and deemed elections, supplements and overrun tracking, and a close-out checklist. Works in demo mode the moment it is dropped on a screen and connects to Dataverse, SharePoint, collections or a Power Pages partner portal.
features: Approval chain from configurable amount tiers (gross or net)
Partner ballots with WI, net share and consent vs JOA threshold
Deemed non-consent after the ballot deadline
Supplemental AFEs for overruns above a threshold
Approved vs actual vs EAC bars
Configurable close-out checklist and overdue close-outs
Bulk moves, CSV export, delete with undo
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set AfeJvApprovalConsole + field AfeJvApprovalConsolePortal)
